baseline_models.focus_anchor: yujadiluna fi ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible sign is taken into a tightly wound verbal contest while the decisive proof that should govern the exchange is absent. The dispute therefore tightens around itself and substitutes contestive force for warrant.

activation_trace.role: The literal tightly twisted cord supplies the dispute's self-tightening material structure.
The literal entangled verbal contest identifies speech, rivalry, and attempted dominance as the active process.
The literal manifest mark makes the disputed object something available for recognition rather than an empty topic.
The literal compelling proof supplies the missing governor whose absence lets verbal force impersonate evidence.

changed_reading.before: They dispute God's signs without proof.
changed_reading.after: They wind a manifest sign into a self-tightening contest and use verbal dominance where a compelling warrant should have governed the exchange.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same enlargement root marks both the greatness of the revulsion and the self-enlarging agent. Self-magnification rebounds as an enlarged, heavy moral consequence rather than producing genuine stature.

activation_trace.role: The literal magnifying of something in the breast links perceived greatness to an inward act of appraisal.
The literal self-exalting greatness supplies the agent's attempted upward movement.
The literal greatness that becomes difficult and heavy turns enlargement into burdensome consequence.
The literal intense loathing of one who undertakes ugliness supplies the moral weight that rebounds on the self-enlarger.

changed_reading.after: Their act of making themselves great returns as a greatly magnified and heavy revulsion, so the sentence reverses the direction of their enlargement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: inda Allahi wa inda alladhina amanu
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated locative places one moral finding in two evaluative presences. Believing perception does not originate the verdict but becomes aligned with the divine measure, isolating the disputant from both transcendent and trustworthy human recognition.

activation_trace.role: The literal nearness and presence creates two co-present sites in which the same conduct is assessed.
The literal severe aversion supplies the shared evaluative finding carried across both presences.
The literal heart-settling assent makes the human evaluators those whose recognition has settled toward truth.

changed_reading.before: God and believers both hate the conduct.
changed_reading.after: The conduct fails in two aligned courts of presence: the divine measure and the settled recognition of believers, leaving the disputant outside both.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: yatbau Allahu ala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbarin
baseline_models.mechanism: The heart is not merely covered. It is imagined as a reversing cognitive core filled to capacity and then impressed into the comprehensive pattern of self-exaltation and coercion.

activation_trace.role: The literal seal and impressed image supplies the fixing action on the heart.
The literal filling to the limit makes the closure a saturation process rather than only an external lid.
The literal encompassing whole extends the impressed condition across the heart rather than one isolated opinion.
The literal heart as understanding and inner awareness locates the process in the cognitive-affective core.
The literal turning of a thing from one face to another makes lost reversibility the faculty that the stamp arrests.
The literal coercive compulsion supplies the fixed outward behavior into which the saturated heart is impressed.

changed_reading.before: God seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.
changed_reading.after: A reversible core becomes saturated and stamped throughout with a repeatable pattern of self-exaltation and coercion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier recurrence gives the contest an explicit operation: unreal speech is wound around stable truth in order to make it slip from its footing. Warrantless dispute is therefore tactical displacement, not neutral inquiry.

activation_trace.role: The literal tight twisting anchors the focus dispute as a constructed verbal pressure.
The literal entangled contest establishes the same behavior as a recurring class marker.
The literal verbal rivalry supplies the action whose stated instrument is falsehood.
The literal claim with no reality supplies the unreal material used by the contest.
The literal slipping foot supplies the intended loss of stability imposed on truth.
The literal reality-stable truth supplies the fixed object that false disputation tries to dislodge.

structural_cues: 40:5 places a purposive clause after disputing with falsehood: they do it in order to dislodge truth.
40:4 and 40:5 establish the focus wording as a recurrence rather than an isolated event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: contest, unreality, slipping, and stable truth are explicitly sequenced; reader arrow: the slipping image is treated as the dispute's functional aim; alternative: idhad may denote ordinary attempted refutation without a material traction model.

changed_reading.before: The disputants lack a valid argument.
changed_reading.after: They deploy unreal speech as traction against truth, twisting the exchange until what is stable appears to lose its footing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier comparison between God's greater revulsion and their revulsion toward their own selves makes the focus compression kabura maqtan reflexive. The attempted enlargement of self matures into self-repudiation, while the divine verdict exceeds even that late recognition.

activation_trace.role: The literal self-exalting greatness anchors the inflation whose consequence is being traced.
The literal intense aversion supplies the focus consequence of self-inflation.
The two literal occurrences of severe aversion create the comparison between divine and self-directed repudiation.
The literal comparative greatness ranks divine revulsion above the later self-verdict.
The literal self or very identity makes the second revulsion reflexive rather than merely interpersonal.

structural_cues: 40:10 states God's maqt as greater than their maqt of their own selves.
40:35 compresses the same two roots into kabura maqtan and then names the mutakabbir.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same enlargement and revulsion roots recur in a divine-versus-self comparison; reader arrow: the focus is read as compressing that reflexive reversal; alternative: both passages may use greatness only to intensify separate verdicts.

changed_reading.before: Self-magnification attracts a great external condemnation.
changed_reading.after: Self-magnification ripens into repudiation of one's own self, yet even that late self-verdict remains smaller than the divine one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, legitimate signs and compelling warrant move through a delivery chain: messengers come with clear proofs, Moses is sent with signs and manifest authority, and a messenger brings a sign only by divine permission. The focus denial says not merely that evidence is missing, but that no authorized warrant has arrived to them.

activation_trace.role: The literal compelling proof anchors the warrant whose provenance is at issue.
The literal coming and arrival makes absence a failure of authorized delivery, not only logical insufficiency.
The literal arrival supplies the positive counterpart in which messengers actually come to their recipients.
The literal messenger and message supplies the authorized carrier in the delivery chain.
The literal disclosure and visibility makes the delivered proofs openly discriminating.
The literal compelling proof supplies the manifest authority positively sent with Moses.
The literal bringing or arrival states that even a messenger does not originate the sign autonomously.
The literal manifest sign supplies the item whose delivery is governed.
The literal authorization and permission supplies the final source condition for legitimate sign-bearing.

structural_cues: 40:22 pairs messengers' coming with clear proofs.
40:23 pairs being sent with signs and manifest sultan.
40:78 denies any messenger the ability to bring a sign except by God's permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: arrival, messenger, manifest proof, authority, sign, and permission form a repeated delivery sequence; reader arrow: that sequence is treated as the provenance test negated in 40:35; alternative: atahum may simply modify proof without invoking a formal authorization chain.

changed_reading.after: Their speech has no warrant that arrived through the surah's messenger-sign-permission chain, so it is unauthorized as well as unproved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch split within sultan becomes functional in Pharaoh's episode. When compelling proof cannot be answered, threatened killing, self-exaltation, and earthly rule supply coercive power as a counterfeit substitute for proof-power.

activation_trace.role: The literal compelling proof supplies the absent epistemic authority.
The literal overpowering force supplies the nearby but illegitimate substitute for proof.
The literal compulsion and coercion names the behavioral endpoint of replacing proof with force.
The literal taking of life supplies Pharaoh's proposed coercive answer to Moses.
The literal self-exalting greatness explicitly labels the type from whom Moses seeks refuge.
The literal kingdom and sovereignty supplies the institutional capacity through which force can impersonate warrant.

structural_cues: 40:26 places Pharaoh's proposal to kill Moses beside his claim to protect religion and land.
40:27 immediately characterizes the threat through mutakabbir.
40:29 foregrounds present kingdom and Pharaoh's restriction of public vision to what he himself sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: threatened killing, mutakabbir, and kingdom cluster around rejected proofs; reader arrow: coercive sultan is read as a counterfeit for evidentiary sultan; alternative: the political episode may exemplify tyranny without defining every warrantless dispute.

changed_reading.before: An arrogant coercer argues despite lacking proof.
changed_reading.after: Because proof-power is absent, the arrogant ruler makes coercive power perform as proof, converting failed persuasion into threatened violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding history supplies repeated clarity, sustained interpenetrating doubt, excess beyond limit, and disorientation. The seal reads as the accumulated impression of a practiced response to disclosure, while still remaining an act attributed to God.

activation_trace.role: The literal seal and impressed image anchors the final fixing of a repeated pattern.
The literal filling to capacity supplies the cumulative dimension of the closure.
The literal becoming manifest supplies the clarity repeatedly met by resistance.
The literal interpenetration of alternatives without settled certainty supplies the durable doubtful response.
The literal loss of right direction supplies the trajectory produced by the repeated response.
The literal exceeding of a limit supplies the repeated overrun that saturates the heart.
The literal agitated suspicion supplies the unsettled condition that becomes paradoxically fixed.

structural_cues: 40:34 is immediately adjacent to the focus and narrates clear proofs followed by persistent doubt.
40:34 ends with musrif murtab; 40:35 continues with those who dispute and then the divine sealing formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: clarity, persistence, doubt, excess, disorientation, and sealing are adjacent; reader arrow: repeated resistance is treated as the material accumulated into the stamp; alternative: divine sealing may be a prior cause of closure rather than a ratification of habituation.

changed_reading.before: The seal is a sudden closure imposed on an arrogant heart.
changed_reading.after: God fixes a response-pattern already filled by repeated encounters in which manifest evidence is converted into excess, agitation, and renewed doubt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact later recurrence locates only kibr in the breasts and says its object will not be reached. The next comparison recalibrates greatness by measured creation, and refusal of worship then reverses attempted ascent into abasement. The focus mutakabbir is therefore running a failed scale-and-direction program.

activation_trace.role: The literal self-exalting greatness anchors the attempted upward movement in the focus.
The literal source from which actions issue locates the disputation's motive inside the breast.
The literal inward magnification identifies kibr as the breast's operative appraisal.
The literal reaching of a limit supplies the explicitly failed attainment sought by self-enlargement.
The literal measuring and proportioning of creation supplies the scale on which greatness is recalibrated.
The literal greater magnitude places cosmic creation above human self-estimation.
The literal humble worship and obedience supplies the downward orientation rejected by self-exaltation.
The literal abasement supplies the inverse descent produced by refusing humble worship.

structural_cues: 40:56 repeats the focus's dispute-without-sultan clause and then names unreached kibr in the breasts.
40:57 immediately states that creating the heavens and earth is greater than creating people.
40:60 opposes arrogance toward worship to entry in abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: interior kibr, failed reaching, comparative cosmic creation, refused worship, and abasement occur in sequence; reader arrow: they are linked as one miscalibrated ascent that reverses direction; alternative: 40:57 may be an independent resurrection argument and 40:60 an independent warning.

changed_reading.before: Mutakabbir names a generally proud coercive person.
changed_reading.after: The mutakabbir inflates the inner scale toward a greatness never reached, rejects the corrective descent of worship, and is driven into the opposite descent of abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's stamp is set against later divine forming of human appearance. Between them, turning away and knowing denial supply an acquired counter-direction. The heart's moral imprint can thus be read as a counter-form produced through repeated reversal of a well-given form.

activation_trace.role: The literal model or mold supplies the focus's acquired inward pattern.
The literal turning from one face to another supplies the reversible faculty redirected by the counter-imprint.
The literal turning away from a proper face supplies the directional deformation preceding the fixed pattern.
The literal denial despite knowledge supplies agency in the acquisition of the counter-pattern.
The literal fashioned appearance supplies the well-given form against which the inward stamp is contrasted.

structural_cues: 40:63 pairs being turned with knowing denial of God's signs.
40:64 immediately recalls God's forming and beautifying of human forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: inward molding, directional turning, knowing denial, and divinely given form are supplied; reader arrow: the seal is treated as an acquired counter-imprint against created form; alternative: tab and taswir may remain independent acts with no intended form-versus-imprint contrast.

changed_reading.before: The seal simply blocks the heart.
changed_reading.after: Repeated knowing reversals acquire a counter-imprint in the heart, set in tension with the well-proportioned form originally given by God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes a contrast between what is held 'with them' as knowledge and what is assessed 'with God' and 'with the believers.' Self-satisfied possession becomes an enclosed epistemic court whose verdict is overturned and surrounded by what it mocked.

activation_trace.role: The literal presence and nearness supplies the two aligned evaluative locations of the focus.
The literal seal supplies the closure of a self-validating epistemic location.
The literal exultant self-satisfaction supplies the affect that protects possessed knowledge from correction.
The literal presence marks knowledge as what is locally held with them, forming a rival evaluative site.
The literal disclosure to a knower supplies the knowledge whose possession is mistaken for exhaustive authority.
The literal descent and enclosure of harm supplies the collapse of the self-contained court under what it excluded.

structural_cues: 40:83 says they rejoiced in the knowledge with them and were then enclosed by what they mocked.
40:35 repeats inda to place revulsion with God and with believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: knowledge 'with them' and verdicts 'with God' and 'with believers' reuse the same locative field; reader arrow: these are read as rival epistemic courts; alternative: the locative recurrence may be rhetorical without establishing a technical contrast of knowledge-sites.

changed_reading.before: The repeated inda merely names who feels revulsion.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes aligned divine-believing judgment from a self-satisfied stock of knowledge 'with them,' making the seal an enclosure within a rival local court.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the repair and splint branches are distant from the coercive adjectival use of jabbar. It remains anchored in jabbar, the tightly wound dispute, and the molding action of tab; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of jabbar here.

activation_trace.role: The literal repair of fracture and deficiency supplies the coercer's imagined role as one who forcefully corrects a broken order.
The literal rigid splint binding a break supplies the force-fitting method of the imagined repair.
The literal tight winding supplies the binding pressure used by the self-appointed repairer.
The literal mold or prescribed pattern supplies the form into which signs and heart are force-fitted.

changed_reading.before: Jabbar is only the coercive result of a sealed heart.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the coercer imagines himself repairing a fracture in reality, but does so by winding signs into a rigid splint and force-fitting the heart to his own mold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote majdal-building branch of jadal through Pharaoh's later tower. It remains anchored in the focus dispute and self-exaltation while the context supplies high building, reaching, connection, and attempted inspection; downstream prose should call it a whole-surah architectural analogy, not an etymological equation.

activation_trace.role: The literal fortified majdal building supplies an architectural image for a dispute made into a self-protecting construction.
The literal self-exalting greatness supplies the construction's vertical ambition.
The literal high edifice supplies Pharaoh's concrete monumental substitute for received warrant.
The literal reaching of an endpoint supplies the tower-argument's claimed ability to attain what it judges.
The literal rope or connection supplies the fabricated links by which the construction claims ascent.
The literal overlooking and inspecting an affair supplies the attempted mastery gained from the constructed height.

changed_reading.before: The disputant verbally resists an authority that never came to him.
changed_reading.after: The disputant builds a fortified argument-tower from self-made connections, then claims its height lets him inspect and dismiss what only authorized warrant could disclose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads later punishment imagery back into the focus's material branch images. It remains anchored by the exact recurrence of jadal about the signs followed by turning, neck-fetters, linked chains, and dragging; downstream prose should mark it as a material echo across the surah, not claim that jadal lexically means chains.

activation_trace.role: The literal tightly wound cord supplies the inward verbal braid that initiates the material sequence.
The literal seal supplies the first fixed constraint, located inwardly on the heart.
The repeated literal winding of dispute reconnects the focus behavior directly to the later outcome sequence.
The literal turning away from a face supplies the directional loss produced by the recurrent braid.
The literal collar that fetters a limb externalizes fixed constraint at the neck.
The literal connected links externalize the repeated verbal construction as a binding series.
The literal extended twisting succession makes the chain a material counterpart to the wound dispute.
The literal dragging and extending reverses the disputant from manipulator of verbal strands into the object pulled by them.

changed_reading.before: Warrantless dispute produces an inwardly sealed heart.
changed_reading.after: The speaker who winds discourse around the signs becomes, in the surah's later material echo, the bound object inside connected coils and is dragged in the direction to which his own turning led.

strongest_changes: The absent sultan became a broken authorization chain, not merely missing evidence.
Pharaoh's sequence exposed coercive power as a counterfeit substitute for compelling proof.
The 40:56-60 recurrence turned kibr into a failed scale-and-direction program ending in inverse abasement.
The adjacency of 40:34 made sealing legible as the fixing of an accumulated response-pattern.
The final inda recurrence opened rival epistemic courts: knowledge held with them versus judgment with God and believers.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the compact focus through linked material mechanisms: braid and slippage, delivery and authorization, proof and coercion, scale and reversal, form and counter-imprint, and finally braid becoming chain.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal direction between repeated rejection and divine sealing remains underdetermined.
The proof-power and coercive-power branches of sultan illuminate substitution without proving that both senses are simultaneously asserted in the focus.
The repairer, tower, and chain readings are anchored material analogies and require explicit exploratory qualification.
